description: This Java class 'GenericResultsetData' represents an immutable data object encapsulating general result set data, including column headers and rows, with utility methods to access column types and check data presence.

classes.name: GenericResultsetData
classes.description: Immutable data object for generic resultset data.

methods.name: getColumnHeaders
methods.description: Returns the list of column header data.

methods.name: getData
methods.description: Returns the list of row data.

methods.name: getColTypeOfColumnNamed
methods.description: Retrieves the column type for the specified column name.

methods.name: hasNoEntries
methods.description: Checks if the result set has no data entries.

methods.name: hasEntries
methods.description: Checks if the result set has any data entries.

methods.name: hasMoreThanOneEntry
methods.description: Checks if the result set contains more than one data entry.
